question.problem:
$$
f(x,y)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}{10}, & 0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 3 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}\,{f}_{X}(x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{3{x}^{2}+9}{10}, & 0\le x\le 1 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$

Consider the continuous random variables $X$ and $Y,$ for which the joint probability density function $f(x,y)$ and the marginal density function ${f}_{X}(x)$ are shown above. Find the expression of the conditional probability density function ${f}_{Y\,|\,X}(y\,|\,x)$ for $0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 3.$
question.worked_solution:
Recall that the conditional probability density function of $Y$ given $X=x$ for two continuous random variables $X$ and $Y$ is given by

$$
{f}_{Y\,|\,X}(y\,|\,x)=\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{X}(x)},
$$

where

- $f(x,y)$ is the joint probability density function for $X$ and $Y,$ and

- ${f}_{X}(x)$ is the marginal density function for $X.$

Now, for $0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 3,$ we have 

$$
\begin{aligned}{f}_{Y\,|\,X}(y\,|\,x) & =\frac{f(x,y)}{{f}_{X}(x)} \\  & =\frac{(\frac{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}{10})}{(\frac{3{x}^{2}+9}{10})} \\  & =\frac{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}{3{x}^{2}+9}.\end{aligned}
$$

For other values of $x$ and $y,$ the function $f(x,y)$ equals $0.$ As a result, ${f}_{Y\,|\,X}(y\,|\,x)$ will be equal to $0$ too.

Therefore, the conditional probability density function is the following:

$$
{f}_{Y\,|\,X}(y\,|\,x)=\{\begin{aligned}\frac{{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}}{3{x}^{2}+9}, & 0\le x\le 1,\,0\le y\le 3 \\ 0, & \text{otherwise}\end{aligned}
$$
